facades.name: north (canal front)
facades.note: Rectified panorama, the east 33 m left of the tree (38.1 px/m: photo x 0-1260 px). Bottom band: basement windows hidden behind parked bicycles (null). Four clear vision bands, one ribbon each. Depth band 3 m: the roof plant stands 9-11 m behind the face and does not show from the street.

facades.name: south (entrance front)
facades.note: Main block front west of the transverse workshop block (span: native T ~ u, -42..2.9 m; the transverse block stands 40 m further south and would otherwise sit in front of the lower front east of u 2.9; pic3 does not show it). Front plane pinned to the white wall (v 5.25). Oblique Commons view: the sokkel band is hidden by the black wall and the white wall (null); four clear vision bands, one ribbon each (the entrance doors join the ground-storey band).
